carryingLoot.opening: A lantern comes up full in your face, and a second one behind it: the city watch. You're inside the customs' wall at night with your arms full of the crown's goods, and they take it all back. The sergeant looks you over, scarf and wand and all, and sighs.
carryingLoot.outcome: You drop the lot and run, and Port Calder's lanes hide you the way they hide everyone. You also know the sergeant saw your face.

firstSurrenderAfterEscape: A night in the cells again, and in the morning the same magistrate, who remembers you and doubles the fine. Your purse won't be the same this break.

yard.outcome: You slip through the gap and the cat comes with you, tail up, as if showing you round.

next.opening: Across the yard, in the customs house, a clerk is working late: sleeve-garters, a lamp, a ledger. Between you and the warehouse door lies the square of light from his window.

ballroom.outcome: You go up the little iron stair among the hanging ferns, and come out on the upper floor behind a curtain.

next.opening: An old lady in diamonds takes your arm with surprising strength. "You'll do," she says. "My nephew's vanished, and the quadrille's starting." The dance would take you the length of the ballroom, to the foot of the stairs.

mewsEntry.outcome: At eleven you go in by the mews door behind a tray of ices, as if you'd carried one all your life.
